bodies.linkedin:
The schemablind SQL agent operates without being provided a database schema. It interacts with unknown databases using four specific verbs: list_tables, describe_table, sample_rows, and run_sql_readonly.

Guessing an encoding is the most common way to write a query that runs cleanly and returns the wrong answer. The sample_rows verb is used to determine the actual format of data values, such as whether a flag uses 0/1 or 'Y'/'N' encoding.

Batching describe_table into one call reduced turns from 9.0 to 5.6 and tokens from 13,024 to 8,576. On the held-out half, the agent costs 11,816 tokens over 6.6 turns.

The daily token cap of 200,000 is per model. Runs that encounter a daily refusal are abandoned rather than scored to prevent inaccurate performance reporting.

The primary goal of measurement is to generate an accuracy-cost curve to identify where performance flattens, rather than determining a single best model.
bodies.thread:
The oracle scores 100% on all 500 real Mini-Dev questions. This confirms the scorer holds against real data and not only a fixture built to suit it.

A SQL agent should operate without being provided a database schema. It interacts with unknown databases using four specific verbs: list_tables, describe_table, sample_rows, and run_sql_readonly.

The sample_rows verb is used to determine the actual format of data values. This helps identify if a flag uses 0/1 or 'Y'/'N' encoding, as guessing is the most common way to write a query that runs cleanly but returns the wrong answer.

Batching describe_table into one call reduced turns from 9.0 to 5.6 and tokens from 13,024 to 8,576.

The daily token cap is the primary factor that blocks model execution, rather than financial costs. Runs that encounter a daily refusal are abandoned rather than scored to prevent inaccurate performance reporting.

The primary goal of measurement is to generate an accuracy-cost curve to identify where performance flattens, rather than determining a single best model.
